name: hardhat-base
description: Hardhat-only Scaffold-HBAR base: Next.js frontend, sample HTS contracts, conventional root scripts, and no default keys.

envVars.description: packages/nextjs/.env.local, optional. WalletConnect project id. Empty: only browser-injected wallets and the burner wallet are offered.
packages/nextjs/.env.local, optional. JSON-RPC URL the frontend uses for Hedera testnet (default https://testnet.hashio.io/api).
packages/nextjs/.env.local, optional. JSON-RPC URL the frontend uses for Hedera mainnet (default https://mainnet.hashio.io/api).
packages/nextjs/.env.local, optional. Mirror Node base URL behind the /api/hedera/account route on testnet (default https://testnet.mirrornode.hedera.com).
packages/nextjs/.env.local, optional. Mirror Node base URL behind the /api/hedera/account route on mainnet (default https://mainnet.mirrornode.hedera.com).
packages/hardhat/.env, optional. JSON-RPC URL the local Hardhat network forks (default https://testnet.hashio.io/api).
packages/hardhat/.env. Password-encrypted deployer key. Never fill it by hand: the hardhat:account:generate and hardhat:account:import scripts write it.

steps.label: Deploy the sample contracts to it
Create an encrypted deployer account, then fund it from the faucet
